verdict.line: You lose if you stand still eating free Parrrley pokes while he farms CS from range; you win if you force him into melee range and burst him down before Remove Scurvy comes off cooldown.

brief.thesis: Gangplank's Q (Parrrley, 625 range, 5s cooldown) outranges every tool Riven has — Q (Broken Wings) reaches 275, E (Valor) reaches 250 — so he can poke and last-hit from a distance she cannot contest. Riven's only win condition is closing that gap: use E to absorb a shot on approach, then land the full Q-W-Q burst before his W (Remove Scurvy, 18-22s cooldown) cleanses the stun and heals the damage back.

theirWindow.when: he's poking from max Parrrley range
theirWindow.what: Back off between farm rather than facetanking chip damage you have no way to answer at range.

yourWindow.when: he steps inside your E/Q range
yourWindow.what: Immediately chain E to block/close, then Q into W (Ki Burst) into Q — this only locks him down if Remove Scurvy is on cooldown, so track it before committing.

start.why: The sustain and extra damage offset the Parrrley chip you can't dodge early and keep you threatening in short trade windows.

boots.why: The ability haste tightens your W/E loop, letting you re-engage and re-block pokes more often per minute.

core.why: Cooldown reduction on your ultimate means more Wind Slash windows to punish him stepping up or walking back to range.
Sustained damage and healing help you win the extended poison exchange his Grog-Soaked Blade forces.
Converts his poke and poison damage into delayed damage you can heal back through, so burst trades favor you even after eating a Parrrley.

situational.when: you're ahead early and want the shield proc to force a clean all-in before he can kite
his Grog-Soaked Blade poison and poke are stacking up as your main source of damage taken
fights are going long and you need the lifesteal proc to outlast his Remove Scurvy heal

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking adaptive force and the max-stack heal against champions let you out-sustain the Grog-Soaked Blade poison once you're forced into a prolonged exchange.

summoners.why: Ignite's burn persists through Remove Scurvy's heal, so it's the cleanest way to punish an all-in window even if he cleanses and heals off your W stun.

playing.title: Don't facetank Parrrley
playing.detail: His Q (Parrrley, 625 range, 5s cooldown) outranges your entire kit — step out between CS rather than absorbing free pokes you can't trade back.

playing.title: Use E to close, not just escape
playing.detail: E (Valor, 250 range) blocks incoming damage while you dash — use it to eat a trailing Parrrley or auto as you close distance, not only to disengage.

playing.title: Check Remove Scurvy before all-in
playing.detail: If his W (18-22s cooldown) is down, your W (Ki Burst) stun actually holds and you can chain Q-W-Q for the full burst. If it's up, expect the stun cleansed and the damage healed back.

playing.title: Bank Q charges for the engage
playing.detail: Don't burn Broken Wings charges poking from range — save all three hits, including the knockback on the third, for when you're already in his face.

playing.title: Use R to seal the trade
playing.detail: R (Blade of the Exile) grants bonus AD, range, and a one-time Wind Slash — use it to extend damage past his Remove Scurvy heal or catch him walking back to range.

playing.title: Respect Cannon Barrage at 6+
playing.detail: Once he's level 6, don't sit on low health near plates or objectives — Cannon Barrage (120-115s cooldown) slows and deals damage over time anywhere on the map.

playing.title: Win fights fast
playing.detail: His passive poison (Grog-Soaked Blade) ticks regardless of who's landing hits, so short decisive trades favor you far more than standing exchanges.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and all win-rate figures are measured from real games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis of the kits, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Try to not get hit by Gangplank’s Grasp of the Undying + (Q) ability. Close in to nuke Gangplank whenever he steps within range, but keep an eye out to absorb the damage on his Powder Keg(E) with your [E].
